notes: The supplied studies and photos are requirements evidence, not permission to invent legacy formulas or write live data. On the throwaway MariaDB tenant, PHP-owned karat and metal-stock schemas were inspected and reconciled before confirmed writes; tagged karat and metal rows persisted, direct SQL readback matched the submitted values, dry-run requests returned writes=0 with writesBlocked=true, invalid karat input was denied, and cleanup returned tagged rows to zero. The authenticated Jewellery masters HTTP surface rendered the company-scoped karat row after the required dependent master tables were provisioned. The barcode-purchase/tag tranche then passed separate dry-run and confirmed paths: barcode purchase calculation/readback (metal value 812.50, total cost 887.50, margin 133.13, selling price 1020.63), available-to-sold transition, tag creation/history, sold transition/history, duplicate-sale denial, and wrong-company denial; authenticated HTML readback confirmed the Jewellery surface and company=2 context, but did not expose the tagged rows in the rendered list. The fixing tranche provisioned the PHP-owned fixing and fix/unfix schemas, passed purchase-fixing dry-run with writes=0 and writesBlocked=true, confirmed a throwaway purchase-fixing row with PF/GMS/22K values, read it back directly from SQL, rendered the authenticated purchase-fixing HTML with company=2 context, rejected a missing-party confirmed request with zero writes, and cleaned all tagged fixing rows to zero. The local fixture initially diverged from PHP (reduced karat/metal schemas and absent dependent master tables), so voucher sale/return, fix/unfix settlement, audit-log, repair transfer/receive/delivery, true browser interaction, second-database isolation, recovery, UAT, and production gates remain open. PHP remains authoritative and liveTenantWrites remains false.
